en.title: Tokyo adopts ME/CFS disability certification; Microsoft and Google advance accessibility features
en.summary: Tokyo has begun using the FUNCAP evaluation method for issuing disability handbooks related to ME/CFS, incorporating post‑exertional malaise criteria. Meanwhile, Microsoft is testing a new Screen Tint feature in Windows 11 that provides customizable color overlays to reduce eye strain, and Google Photos is preparing a fix for its accessibility problem that hinders users with disabilities.

highlights.title: Tokyo adopts FUNCAP for ME/CFS disability certification
Microsoft tests Screen Tint accessibility feature in Windows 11
Google Photos has an accessibility problem, but a fix is finally on the way

zh-TW.title: 東京採用ME/CFS殘障認證；微軟與Google推進無障礙功能
zh-TW.summary: 東京已開始使用FUNCAP評估方法，針對ME/CFS發放身心障礙手冊，並納入運動後不適症狀標準。同時，微軟正在Windows 11測試新的Screen Tint功能，提供可自訂的顏色覆蓋層以減輕眼睛疲勞；Google Photos則正在修復影響殘障使用者的無障礙問題。

highlights.title: 東京採用 FUNCAP 進行 ME/CFS 殘障認證
Microsoft 在 Windows 11 測試 Screen Tint 無障礙功能
Google Photos 存在無障礙問題，但修復即將推出
